items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Harry Gray in the context of union politics and Petrillo ('Petrello and Gray were holding hands', 'Harry Gray, the president of the black local'), but does not describe a direct personal, musical, or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: Well, your band at the Delisa was -- had some white musicians in it occasionally.
Oh, yeah, but that was fine. But, see, the only thing about this is Petrello and Gray were holding hands.
Well, that was always the story, that they had an agreement.
